Author: Akari
Name: Venue Helper
Punchline: An all-in-one toolkit for FFXIV venue hosts: attendance, raffles, auctions, giveaways, deathroll tournaments, bar games, menus, and quick announcements.
Description:
An all-in-one venue host toolkit. Open with /venuehelper (aliases /vhelp, /vh).

- Venue Counter: a lap counter plus an all-night running total, multiple venues each with their own visitor set, and a lifetime time-in-venue database with per-visit breakdowns.
- Raffle Helper: ticket counts, free/comp tickets, player notes, a configurable house cut, auto-assigned numbers (0-999, shuffleable), clipboard import, trade auto-credit, and a name-only wheel export.
- Auction Helper: target-to-add, sold-to-house (negative) sales, house cut, gil shorthand (type 3.4M), a date-filtered history with per-row delete, and buyer tracking across alts.
- Giveaway Helper: capture first /random, then highlight the highest, lowest, closest, or exact-match winner; rejects range-gaming /random N (and counts /dice only if you allow it).
- DR Tourny Helper: single OR double elimination deathroll brackets with randomized seeding, automatic roll detection, roll-offs, and best-of-3 finals.
- Shout/Yell Helper: pre-written announcements (add/remove as many as you like), each on its own channel, fired with one click.
- Bar Game Helper: custom roll games with trade-based buy-ins, live roll capture, a fixed or stacking pot, and survival games (same number, higher/lower vs a set number, or call higher/lower vs the previous roll) with fixed, tiered, or high-score payouts. Manual roll entry for early rollers.
- Menu Helper: per-venue menu profiles; each item has a price and a macro-style serve sequence (multi-step emotes/commands with per-step delays) that fires when served; tracks the night's sales per menu with export. Plus reusable macro buttons.
- Settings: a default export folder, a master panic switch (halts all chat/trade automation), a configurable step delay, and backup & restore of everything to a file you control.

Exports can be written as TXT, CSV, PDF, or XLSX to a folder you choose.
